notes.subject: אתם
notes.rationale: Either the direct-object marker with suffix ('engrave it with them / in their presence') or the preposition 'with them'; the ⟨את⟩ marker is preserved and 'u ɲɛ fɛ' bracketed.

notes.subject: na … sɛbɛn
notes.rationale: Command addressed to Isaiah: come, write — a direct summons to the prophet.

notes.subject: Isaiah
notes.rationale: The imperative 'go, write' is addressed to Isaiah.

notes.subject: ליום אחרון לעד עד עולם
notes.rationale: Time measured out — for the last day, for a witness, unto forever — duration heaped in three phrases.

translation: Sisan, na, sɛbɛn a laji kan ⟨u ɲɛ fɛ⟩ ⟨את⟩, ani sɛbɛn dɔ kɔnɔnsɛbɛn-ka-t'a-kan, walasa ka kɛ don laban na seerekɛli ye, fo waati si tɛ ban.

tokens.marks: u ɲɛ fɛ (laji in — the tablet)
